description: This file defines classes and interfaces related to Bluetooth AVDTP (Audio/Video Distribution Transport Protocol) profile, including StreamEndPointData, Client, and Server classes, along with associated enums and nested classes for managing Bluetooth audio streaming endpoints and their capabilities.

classes.name: StreamEndPointData
classes.description: Represents Bluetooth AVDTP stream endpoint data, including capabilities, configuration, and state management.

classes.name: StreamEndPointData::Service
classes.description: Represents a specific service capability within a stream endpoint, including category and parameters.

classes.name: StreamEndPoint
classes.description: Derived from StreamEndPointData, represents a Bluetooth AVDTP stream endpoint with control capabilities.

classes.name: Client
classes.description: Represents a Bluetooth AVDTP client capable of discovering and controlling stream endpoints.

classes.name: Server
classes.description: Abstract base class for Bluetooth AVDTP server, handling incoming signals and managing stream endpoints.

classes.name: IStreamEndPointControl
classes.description: Interface for controlling stream endpoint operations such as start, suspend, open, close, etc.

methods.name: SetConfiguration
methods.description: Sets configuration for a stream endpoint.

methods.name: GetConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves current configuration of a stream endpoint.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts streaming on a specified endpoint.

methods.name: Suspend
methods.description: Suspends streaming on a specified endpoint.
